classification.difficultyReason: Use the prescribed intercept-plus-one-point method, choose a convenient second input and translate the calculated coordinates into each line sketch.

content.prompt: Sketch the graph of each line by calculating the $y$-intercept and finding one other point.

answer.worked:
When $x=0$,
$$\begin{align*}y&=2(0)+1\\y&=1\end{align*}$$
When $x=1$,
$$\begin{align*}y&=2(1)+1\\y&=3\end{align*}$$
Plot $(0,1)$ and $(1,3)$ and draw the straight line through them.

spec.description: Complete line graph with two calculated points; no grid or ticks.
